name: pantry-chef
description: Intelligent cooking assistant: recipe suggestions from your pantry, macros, shopping lists, and live chef coaching.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
